init_OCRVQADataset: create an OCRVQADataset instance with config, dataset_type, and imdb_file_index arguments
preprocess_sample_info_OCRVQADataset: call preprocess_sample_info on OCRVQADataset to pass through sample_info unchanged
format_for_prediction_TextVQA: call format_for_prediction on OCRVQADataset to convert model report into prediction entries
getitem_OCRVQADataset: access an OCRVQADataset item by index to get a Sample with question and answer data
add_answer_info_TextVQA: call add_answer_info on OCRVQADataset to process and attach answer data to a sample
